description: Two independent 3-tap quadratic interpolators per accepted beat. Lane 0 reads s8 samples from a[7:0], a[15:8], a[23:16] and uses phase c[1:0]; lane 1 reads b[7:0], b[15:8], b[23:16] and uses phase c[3:2]; the phase selects mu = 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 exact Lagrange weights in Q14. a[31:24] and b[31:24] are ignored and c[31:4] must be zero. result[7:0] and result[15:8] are the s8 clamped lane outputs, aux[1:0] = per-lane clamp flags, aux[15:8] and aux[23:16] = the pre-clamp rounded values. fault = any lane clamped or malformed control.
hardware_advantage: A fractional delay line wants one weighted 3-tap interpolation per output sample per channel: two lanes retire every enabled beat at II=1 with no multiplier and no coefficient load, where software needs a multiply per tap.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
